title: impossible-case-default-with-throw (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: All declared string literals are covered by switch cases. The defensive default throw is unreachable for conforming inputs.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. This broad reachability criterion is not a recommendation to warn on defensive throws. PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0 omit the unreachable-default diagnostic. Pinned Mago main bbabf3395981 reports the actual fact as unreachable-switch-default at line 8. Independent review replaced the initially assumed generic unreachable-code identifier with that observed switch-specific code, so the comparison records the improvement rather than a spurious mixed result. The unreachable-default expectation itself is unchanged. Psalm's implementation only checks impossible defaults in handleNonReturningCase; that explains its silence here but does not establish a documented unsupported policy.
